subject: Procurement intake — portal partition plan for renewal & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@helixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal intake — onboarding refresh + capacity uplift

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. We are ready to start the renewal/expansion paperwork for our Helix Health paid environment (account HLX). Two items to surface up front so we can align:

1) Procurement portal: we need the steps/URLs to re-run vendor onboarding (new PO/attestation path) — our procurement team requires the portal flow for our internal audit.
2) PO partitioning: Finance wants the option to split the upcoming PO across two cost centers (ops and research) — is that supported via your portal or do we need multiple POs?
3) Terms: our legal has asked to move the auto-renew to an explicit 12-month term with a one-time invoice cadence (annual) — will this require an amendment?

We expect a ~30% committed capacity increase for the renewal term (estimate: 300M tokens/month). Can you confirm who on your side handles the onboarding evidence bundle (SOC2 attestation, data retention answers) and the procurement contact for PO processing?

I attached our internal PO template and a short intake checklist.

Thanks,
Maya Singh\Senior Procurement Manager\Helix Health

Attachment: Helix_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — onboarding refresh + capacity uplift

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear summary and the template. 

Quick answers up front:
- Procurement portal: use our onboarding portal (https://portal.redwood.com/onboard/helix) — I'll kick off the vendor re-certification lane and send the evidence checklist. Our onboarding team owns the attestation upload; Laura will be your finance lead for billing/PO ingestion.
- PO partitioning: the portal supports multiple PO uploads tied to one subscription if you prefer separate cost-center lines. If you need a single consolidated invoice with internal allocations, we'll coordinate with Finance.
- Terms: switching to an explicit 12-month annual invoice is an amendment — we typically issue an amendment and attach it to the PO. Legal may need a quick sign-off window (we can do DocuSign).

Next steps:
1) Jonas will prepare a mutual action plan with timelines for onboarding + evidence.
2) Laura will confirm the PO ingestion path and whether we should accept two PO files versus one split line.
3) I will open the portal request and route the Helix template to our onboarding queue.

I'll also drop the evidence checklist to this thread.

Best,
Evelyn Hart\Account Director, Strategic Sales\Redwood Inference

Hi Maya — looping in the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) below; attaching a short renewal MA plan and the PO ingestion checklist. Please review and tell us the preferred PO partition approach.

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Day 0 (today): Redwood opens vendor re-certification lane and shared evidence checklist.
- Day 2–5: Helix uploads signed PO(s) and completes SOC2 attestation form.
- Day 7–10: Finance ingests PO(s), accounts team provisions capacity uplift, and we confirm billing cadence.
- Day 14: If amendment needed, parties sign via DocuSign and we lock the renewed term.

Options for PO routing:
A) Two separate POs uploaded to the portal (preferred if Helix wants lines separated by cost center).
B) Single PO with internal allocation note — Redwood will ingest and create two internal invoice lines (may add a short reconciliation note).
